ur.title: Ek billi ki wajah se jahannam?! 😢 Us aurat ne aisa kya kiya…
alts: Pinjre mein band ek billi… aur ek aurat ka sabse bada gunah
Ek chhoti si billi, ek band pinjra… aakhir tak dekhna
ur.description:
Ek aangan. Ek lakdi ka pinjra. Andar ek chhoti si billi, jo baar baar bahar dekhti hai…
Aur ek aurat, jo roz uske saamne se guzar jaati hai. Phir kya hua?

💬 Aapke ghar ya gali mein koi jaanwar hai jiska aap khayal rakhte hain?

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 2365
(Kahani mein kuch hisse, jaise pinjra aur aakhri seekh wala manzar, tasawwur par mabni hain. Hadith ka hissa bilkul usi tarah hai.)
🔔 Har hafte ek nayi Islamic kahani: subscribe karein.

en.title: Hell because of a cat?! 😢 What did this woman do…
alts: A cat locked in a cage… and one woman's biggest sin
One small cat, one locked cage… watch till the end
en.description:
A courtyard. A wooden cage. Inside, a little cat keeps looking out…
And a woman walks past it every day. What happened next?

💬 Is there an animal near your home that you look after?

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 2365
(Some parts of the story, like the cage and the final lesson scene, are imagined. The Hadith part is told exactly.)
🔔 A new Islamic story every week: subscribe.

lines.text: Kya tum jaante ho? Ek billi ki wajah se ek aurat ko jahannam ki saza mili!
lines.voiceText: क्या तुम जानते हो? एक बिल्ली की वजह से एक औरत को जहन्नम की सज़ा मिली!

en.text: Did you know? Because of a cat, a woman was punished with Hell!

lines.text: Ek aurat ne ek billi ko qaid kar diya, aur use azaad nahi kiya.
lines.voiceText: एक औरत ने एक बिल्ली को क़ैद कर दिया, और उसे आज़ाद नहीं किया।

en.text: A woman locked up a cat, and never set it free.

lines.text: Na usne billi ko khana diya, na paani... aur na use chhoda, ki woh zameen ke keede-makode kha leti.
lines.voiceText: न उसने बिल्ली को खाना दिया, न पानी... और न उसे छोड़ा, कि वह ज़मीन के कीड़े-मकोड़े खा लेती।

en.text: She gave it no food, no water... and she would not let it go to eat the small creatures of the earth.

lines.text: Waqt guzarta gaya. Bechari billi bhookh aur pyaas se kamzor hoti gayi.
lines.voiceText: वक़्त गुज़रता गया। बेचारी बिल्ली भूख और प्यास से कमज़ोर होती गई।

en.text: Time went by. The poor cat grew weaker from hunger and thirst.

lines.text: Aakhirkar, woh bejubaan billi bhookh se mar gayi.
lines.voiceText: आख़िरकार, वह बेज़ुबान बिल्ली भूख से मर गई।

en.text: In the end, that helpless cat died of hunger.

lines.text: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bataya: isi wajah se woh aurat jahannam mein daakhil hui.
lines.voiceText: रसूलुल्लाह सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम ने बताया: इसी वजह से वह औरत जहन्नम में दाख़िल हुई।

en.text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: because of this, that woman entered the Fire.

lines.text: Yaad rakho, bejubaan jaanwaron par reham karna bhi hamari zimmedari hai.
lines.voiceText: याद रखो, बेज़ुबान जानवरों पर रहम करना भी हमारी ज़िम्मेदारी है।

en.text: Remember, showing mercy to animals who cannot speak is our duty too.
